name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: The world's largest health assurance scheme, providing free secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage to poor families.
eligibility: Families listed in the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) database, typically rural poor, landless households, and informal laborers.
benefits: Provides free health cover of up to ₹5,000,000 (5 Lakhs) per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization treatment.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: An income support scheme that provides direct financial assistance to landholding farmers to purchase agricultural inputs.
eligibility: Small and marginal landholding farmer families across the country (subject to certain institutional exclusions).
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmers.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: A clean cooking fuel scheme that provides deposit-free LPG gas connections to adult women from poor rural households.
eligibility: Adult women from BPL (Below Poverty Line) households, SC/ST, forest dwellers, or beneficiaries of PM Awas Yojana.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection, a free gas stove, and financial assistance for the first cylinder refill.
documents_required: Aadhar Card of the applicant and all adult family members

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: A national mission for financial inclusion to ensure affordable access to banking services, savings accounts, and insurance.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen, particularly the rural poor who do not have a savings account.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card, free ₹2,000,000 accident insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility for eligible account holders.
documents_required: Voter ID, Driving License, or NREGA Job Card (if Aadhar is unavailable)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: A housing scheme providing financial support to construct permanent, safe houses with basic amenities for rural families living in kutcha/temporary houses.
eligibility: Homeless families or families living in temporary, single-room mud (kutcha) houses in rural regions.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹120,000 in plain areas and ₹130,000 in hilly or difficult areas, plus ₹12,000 for toilet construction and 95 days of NREGA labor wages.

name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY)
description: A state-specific health assurance scheme providing free healthcare treatment to families in Odisha at government and empanelled private hospitals.
eligibility: All residents of Odisha holding NFSA (National Food Security Act) or SFSS (State Food Security Scheme) ration cards.
benefits: Cashless treatment of up to ₹500,000 (5 Lakhs) per family per year, and up to ₹1,000,000 (10 Lakhs) for female members of the family.
documents_required: BSKY Smart Health Card or NFSA/SFSS Ration Card

name: KALIA Scheme
description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation, Odisha's flagship welfare scheme supporting farmers and landless agricultural laborers.
eligibility: Small/marginal farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and landless agricultural households in Odisha.
benefits: ₹25,000 per family over 5 seasons for farming inputs, and landless agricultural households get a ₹12,500 one-time grant for allied activities (like poultry, fishery, or goat rearing).
documents_required: Land Ownership Documents (RoR) or tenancy certificate

name: Mission Shakti
description: A self-help group movement in Odisha that empowers rural women by organizing them into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and providing financial support.
eligibility: Self Help Groups (SHGs) formed by rural women residents of Odisha.
benefits: Interest-free loans (0% interest) up to ₹500,000 (5 Lakhs), seed money grants, training, and government procurement opportunities.
documents_required: Aadhar Cards of the group key representatives (President/Secretary)

name: Mamata Scheme
description: A conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme in Odisha to support pregnant and lactating mothers for improved nutrition and healthcare.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women of Odisha, aged 19 years and above, for the first two live births.
benefits: Maternity cash assistance of ₹5,000 paid directly in two installments into the bank account of the beneficiary for nutrition and immunizations.
documents_required: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card / Mamata Card
Aadhar Card of the mother and her husband
